svg.title: Initial amount plus signed rate accumulation
svg.desc: On the same time domain zero to five minutes, the net rate is six minus two t litres per minute and the initial amount is five litres. The positive rate region from zero to three adds nine litres; the negative rate region from three to five removes four litres. Thus the amount is five plus six t minus t squared, reaches a maximum of fourteen litres at three minutes, and ends at ten litres. The maximum follows from the rate changing from positive to negative. Both plots use the same aligned time axis, and all endpoint values are included.
